optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Quality Operations Specialist, Mobility Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Senior Quality Operations Specialist with five years and two months of experience at a regional mobility operator, promoted from Quality Specialist after 18 months, leading a partner quality audit programme covering 900 driver and courier partners.
professionalSummary.witness: Senior Quality Operations Specialist for five years and two months at a regional mobility operator, promoted from quality specialist after the first eighteen months; led the partner quality audit programme covering about 900 driver and courier partners.

experienceHighlights.text: Led the partner quality audit programme for 900 driver and courier partners, including audit sampling, case review, corrective-action tracking, and monthly reporting.
experienceHighlights.witness: led the partner quality audit programme covering about 900 driver and courier partners.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran the audit programme's quarterly sampling, case review sessions with partner managers, and corrective-action tracker, closing actions within agreed deadlines.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the audit programme's quarterly sampling, the case review sessions with the partner managers and the corrective-action tracker, closing actions with the regional managers within the agreed deadlines.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, covering audit results, open corrective actions, and repeat findings, with the director deciding on partner suspensions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, covering audit results, open corrective actions and repeat findings; the director decided any partner suspensions.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a quarterly audit sampling plan, corrective-action tracker extract, and corresponding monthly report with change history as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one quarter's audit sampling plan and corrective-action tracker extract (partner id, finding, action, owner, due date, closure date) and the corresponding monthly report, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

skills.text: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (certified by operator's accredited provider) and ISO 9001:2015 internal auditor qualification.
skills.witness: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (certified by the operator's accredited programme provider, certificate number on file) and ISO 9001:2015 internal auditor course completed with the certification body.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish five years and two months of experience in operations quality, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and ISO 9001 qualifications, and direct evidence of running the audit programme, sampling, case review, corrective-action tracking, and monthly reporting. The materials do not establish the candidate's role in documenting limitations and hand-over conditions at the end of each audit cycle (req_cf66c75bc609).
